citacoes_relidas.trecho: Highway 1 along the Big Sur coast is the basic access route to the area

The Nacimiento-Fergusson Road, a lightly-used County road crossing the Hunter-Liggett Military Reservation and the coastal range, provides the only other access route to the seventy-mile long Big Sur coast from inland areas
